svg.title: Retatrutide 12 mg: Lilly's headline vs the journal's main number
svg.desc: Retatrutide 12 mg mean weight loss at 80 weeks. TRIUMPH-1 (no diabetes): 28.3% efficacy estimand (Lilly headline) vs 25.0% treatment-regimen estimand (NEJM). TRIUMPH-2 (type 2 diabetes): 20.8% efficacy estimand (Lilly) vs 18.8% treatment-regimen estimand (Lancet).
